reason: This changes behavior for AutoroutePart when localizing content (clearing the path so a new permalink is auto-generated instead of cloning the source's), which is a targeted, feature-gated (RequireFeatures ContentLocalization) fix that only affects sites using both Autoroute and ContentLocalization, but could surprise existing sites that relied on the previous cloning behavior for localized routes
